name: Καρυάτιδες

alt: Neoclassical house at night with two caryatid statues supporting a balcony, a small tree in front

name: Προς τη θάλασσα
cap: A worn blue boardwalk between canna flowers on the coast between Athens and Piraeus.
alt: Blue wooden boardwalk between two pale blue posts, framed by tall orange canna flowers against a pale sky

name: Ακρόπολη

alt: View over dense Athens apartment blocks towards the Acropolis under a dark grey sky

name: Χρυσό φως
cap: Two women with shopping bags crossing the street in late-afternoon light.

name: Σταθμός Πελοποννήσου
cap: The closed Peloponnese railway station in Athens, ΑΘΗΝΑΙ still written above the door.
alt: Faded yellow station building with a curved grey roof, the word ΑΘΗΝΑΙ above a clock and an arched iron door

name: Σταθμός Χαλκίδας

cap: An old kafeneio on Amorgos, crammed with ship paintings, clocks, bottles and a turquoise table.

alt: Yellow bilingual sign for the waiting lounge and bar above glass doors in an empty, abandoned terminal

name: Κίτρινη πόρτα

alt: Pale yellow door left ajar next to a cream radiator in an empty room with worn wooden floor

name: Καφενείο, πρωί
cap: A marble table with a sugar shaker in an old kafeneio, copper coffee pots on the counter behind.
